f.title: Sender decides suspected-ADR status and reports unless sender and all reporters deny causality
f.statement: The sender judges, on its own responsibility, whether a case is a suspected ADR based on the causality assessment provided by the reporter, and reports all cases except those that the sender and all reporters judged "causality can be denied". Where the reporters include a lawyer or consumer/non-HCP and also a physician, pharmacist or other HCP, denial of causality by all physician/pharmacist/HCP reporters may be treated as denial by all reporters.

rows.quote: （１）①については、感染症報告が必要である。（２）②～④については、従前から副作用として報告を求めており、今後も同様に報告すること。（３）⑤については、症例報告として報告する必要はないが、抗生物質の使用に伴う当該抗生物質への耐性菌に関し、その耐性メカニズムや出現傾向の変化等に係る知見については、研究報告として扱うべきかどうか、PMDA 医薬品安全対策第一部又は医薬品安全対策第二部に個別に相談すること。（４）⑥については、感染症報告が必要である。国内症例であるか外国症例であるかにかかわらず患者の症状等の詳細情報について調査するとともに、診断根拠を明確にすること。また、当該事例が起きた場合は、PMDA 医薬品安全対策第一部又は医薬品安全対策第二部（体外診断用医薬品の場合は、医療機器品質管理・安全対策部医療機器安全課）に個別に相談すること。

rows.quote_en: (1) For (1), an infection report is required. (2) For (2) to (4), reporting as adverse reactions has been required to date, and they shall continue to be reported in the same manner. (3) For (5), reporting as a case report is not necessary, but for findings on bacteria resistant to an antibiotic arising from its use, such as their resistance mechanism or changes in emergence trends, consult PMDA's Office of Pharmacovigilance I or Office of Pharmacovigilance II individually on whether they should be handled as a research report. (4) For (6), an infection report is required. Regardless of whether it is a domestic or foreign case, investigate detailed information such as the patient's symptoms and clarify the basis of diagnosis. rows.quote_en: How should "cases that may lead to disability" in Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations be considered? A38: [Post-marketing] It refers to cases in which, when the adverse reaction occurred, the patient was at risk of developing dysfunction to a degree that interferes with daily life. It falls under "other events or reactions judged to be medically important conditions" as defined by ICH (see the E2D guideline). It does not mean that disability might have remained if it were more severe. Q39: [Post-marketing] How should "cases requiring hospitalisation in a hospital or clinic, or prolongation of hospitalisation, for treatment" in Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations be considered? A39: [Post-marketing] This corresponds to "requires inpatient hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation for treatment" as defined by ICH (see the E2D guideline). It covers cases where the patient was hospitalised or hospitalisation was prolonged for treatment of the adverse reaction, including cases hospitalised for treatment of the adverse reaction but without any particular intervention (rest therapy). For example, hospitalisation for anaphylactic shock or pseudomembranous colitis falls under this. Hospitalisation for testing or its prolongation, or hospitalisation for observation after the adverse reaction has resolved or improved, is not included.

rows.quote_en: This corresponds to "other events or reactions judged to be medically important conditions" as defined by ICH (see the E2D guideline), that is, important medical events that may not be immediately life-threatening or result in death or hospitalisation but may jeopardise the patient or require intervention or treatment to prevent outcomes such as "results in death", "results in persistent or significant disability/incapacity", "is life-threatening" or "requires inpatient hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation for treatment". For example, allergic bronchospasm requiring intensive treatment in an emergency room etc. or at home, blood dyscrasias or convulsions that do not result in hospitalisation, or drug dependence or drug abuse fall under this. Q41: [Post-marketing] How should "congenital diseases or anomalies in later generations" in Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations be considered? A41: [Post-marketing] It falls under "is a congenital anomaly/birth defect" as defined by ICH (see the E2D guideline) and applies where an abnormality in the newborn is suspected to have been caused by exposure to the drug before or during pregnancy. Examples include organ malformation in newborns due to thalidomide and vaginal cancer in female offspring due to diethylstilbestrol.

rows.quote_en: The following cases constitute measures abroad. (1) Changes to indications or dosage and administration that impose restrictions on grounds of efficacy or safety problems. rows.quote: PMDA から提供を受けた副作用等の症例情報については、原則として製造販売業者からの副作用等の報告を行う必要はないが、以下の場合には、副作用等の報告を行う必要がある。① PMDA から提供を受けた症例が PMDA において詳細調査を行わない症例であり、かつ、その症例が施行規則第 228 条の 20 の規定に該当する症例の場合。 -49 ② PMDA が詳細調査を行う症例であっても、施行規則第 228 条の 20 の規定に該当する症例について、PMDA 以外の医療機関、文献等から同じ症例の情報（情報の多少にかかわらず）を入手した場合。③ PMDA から提供を受けた医薬品被害救済・生物由来製品感染等被害救済症例について、施行規則第 228 条の 20 の規定に該当し、PMDA 以外の医療機関、文献等から追加情報を入手した場合。

rows.quote_en: For case information on adverse reactions etc. provided by PMDA, as a rule the marketing authorisation holder does not need to report the adverse reactions etc., but it needs to report them in the following cases. (1) Where a case provided by PMDA is one on which PMDA will not carry out a detailed investigation, and the case falls under Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations. (2) Where, even for a case on which PMDA carries out a detailed investigation, information on the same case (regardless of the amount of information) is obtained from a medical institution, literature etc. other than PMDA for a case falling under Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations. (3) Where, for an adverse drug reaction relief / biological product infection relief case provided by PMDA, the case falls under Article 228-20 of the Enforcement Regulations and additional information is obtained from a medical institution, literature etc. other than PMDA.

f.title: On resuming reporting after suspension, set the survey period and DSUR as specified and contact PMDA first
f.statement: When lifting the reporting hold and resuming, leave the number of reports blank, set the survey period from the day after the previous periodic report period to the day before the latest start date, attach a DSUR covering one year up to the day before the latest start date, and contact PMDA Review Planning Division in advance of submitting the hold-release request.
